<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get the currently-active labor standard for a TaskType"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/standards/{taskType}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the LaborStandard whose effective range currently covers "now" for this TaskType (EffectiveTo is null), or a 404 if none does.

Without `handlingUnit` the answer is the task-type-only standard, exactly as before. With `handlingUnit` the answer is the standard that APPLIES to that handle: the standard declared for exactly (taskType, handlingUnit) when one is active, otherwise the task-type-only standard (most specific wins, ADR 0035). The returned body's own `handlingUnit` says which of the two answered (absent = the task-type-only one).
